toml:
# Satellites in view and dilution of precision from the equator to the pole: MEO GNSS alone,
# a near-polar LEO constellation alone, and both.
#
# GPS and Galileo orbit at 55 and 56 deg inclination, so north of about 70 deg every MEO
# satellite is on the equatorward half of the sky at low elevation and the vertical geometry
# weakens. The Iridium constellation (six near-polar planes of 11 at 780 km and 86.4 deg, the
# `iridium-stl` preset) converges over the poles. The sweep samples eight longitudes and
# thirteen epochs over two hours at each latitude and reports the mean satellites in view,
# the median PDOP, HDOP and VDOP and the availability (PDOP at or below 6) for each group.
#
# MODELLED: geometry only; ionospheric scintillation, strong at high latitude, is not modelled.
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "polar"
duration_s = 7200.0
step_s = 600.0

[polar]
lat_step_deg = 10.0
lon_step_deg = 45.0
pdop_threshold = 6.0

[[system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
mask_deg = 10.0

[[system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
mask_deg = 10.0

[[system]]
name = "Iridium"
leo_preset = "iridium-stl"
mask_deg = 10.0
